CheckTitle: Log profile retention policy is set to at least 365 days
Description: Verify that the log profile retains activity logs for at least 365 days to meet compliance requirements.
Risk: Logs may be prematurely deleted, hindering long-term security investigations.

Code.CLI: az monitor log-profiles update --name default --set retentionPolicy.days=365 retentionPolicy.enabled=true

Recommendation.Text: Configure the retention policy of log profiles to 365 days or greater.
